dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge curve exhibiting significant falcation from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a small pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep, convex anterior margin transitioning sharply from the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 0.65:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible vertical linear striations on the lateral fin surface; a distinct notch on the lower third of the trailing edge; an anomalous thin filament or projection at the upper leading edge/apex region.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly saturated cyan/aqua monochromatic coloration with high-contrast luminance values along the leading edge.
